rules.statement: A landlord need not establish any grounds of ejectment stipulated in section 22 of the Rent Act No. 7 of 1972 for success in his suit for ejectment if the tenant has repudiated the tenancy.
rules.supporting_quote: In such a case the landlord need not establish any one or more of the grounds of ejectment stipulated in section 22 of the Rent Act No. 7 of 1972 for success in his suit for ejectment.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 22 of the Rent Act No. 7 of 1972
